scope: G1 static indoor traversal; first stage permits foot-floor support and forbids deliberate obstacle contact

invariants: Replanning preserves accepted task and elapsed clock
Changes require explicit version and effective time
Missing deadline does not mean immediate deadline

planner_output.caveat: Predicted feasibility is not a proof; fallback behavior also requires qualification

motor_adapter.implemented_baseline: SONIC native reference pack/unpack -> frozen encoder/FSQ -> decoder conditioned on history -> action29
motor_adapter.current_reference_fields: 10 physical frames at native 0.1 s offsets, each q29 + dq29 + orientation6D; native R640 packing is not a naive reshape
motor_adapter.code: checkpoint-specific post-FSQ code64; direct prediction is a separate experimental arm
motor_adapter.actuation: Versioned joint order, nominal offsets, action scale, gains and limits; do not interpret action29 as raw torque

extensions.vision: Train and test an adapter with realistic uncertainty; the task and motor contract remain versioned
extensions.contact_interaction: Requires contact-aware motor capability and task-specific dynamic validation
extensions.new_robot: Requires new embodiment geometry and adapter plus transfer evaluation
